## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **Japanese Tang-pilgrim importation catalog** by **Enchin** 圓珍 (= **Chishō Daishi** 智證大師), the fifth and last of his preserved catalogs (cf. [KR6s0116](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0116)–[KR6s0119](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0119)). The work uses Enchin's posthumous title **Chishō Daishi** in the catalog title — indicating either a posthumous-edition compilation by Tendai-Jimon successors, or (more likely) the canonical title-form adopted in subsequent Tendai-school transmission. Preserved at T55 no. 2173. *notBefore* = **858**, *notAfter* = **858**. Catalog dynasty 日本.

See [KR6s0116](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0116) for substantive treatment of Enchin and his importation project.
